basic_info.description: 544-546 Grant Ave is a well-maintained three-story mixed-use building located on the main street in San Francisco's historic Chinatown, adjacent to the Financial District. Just three blocks from Portsmouth Square, the Hilton Hotel, and City College, the property offers excellent walkability and easy access to the Financial District, Downtown, and Union Square.  This 3,000-square-foot building sits on a 997-square-foot lot, features a ground-floor commercial space with direct access to a private garage. The upper floors include two residential flats. Additionally, a unique rooftop sunroom features a wet bar and bathroom, offering stunning views of St. Mary's Square and the surrounding cityscape. The entire building is currently owner-occupied and will be delivered vacant. A seismic retrofit has already been completed. The property's APN is 0258-018, and it is zoned Chinatown-Community-Business (CCB).  This property presents a rare opportunity for investors or owner-users to acquire a flexible and desirable mixed-use asset in one of San Francisco's most culturally rich and centrally located neighborhoods.
